title: corner lane (round 3 paused -> finished round 4, 2026-09-25): the CORNER obstacle (v552 L70+) and its unlock card icon; art/lanes/corner.md

entries.purpose: the CORNER (v552, first on L70): a red plate on a blue coil spring, one cell; the ONE sprite the board code loads today (CornerLayer.swift, ObstacleSet.spriteIDs, BoardArt.names; PathCore Validator.spriteIDs) = the UpRight corner (plate facing down-right), which CornerNode rotates per turn

ref.note: L80 cell (0, 0), facing (1, 1): plate faces down-right; the orientation CornerNode draws at angle 0

entries.notes: corner lane (round 3/4, art/lanes/corner.md): 3D route (a rendered-look prop: glossy coils, a rounded plate; the v552 sprite is not flat), drawn at the design pitch 32 pt: a 2 x 2 pitch frame CENTRED on the corner cell centre (anchor = frame centre); the art overflows the cell (plate 1.25 x 0.36 p on the cell diagonal, spring 0.7 p behind it), so the code must size the layer to the sprite (64 pt x pitch/32), not to one cell (code request 1). Pixel-identical to cornerUpRightSpring + cornerUpRightPlate. Rotated as CornerNode does, it reproduces the original for upRight, downRight, downLeft; upLeft is a separate render in the original -> the per-turn layers are the 1:1 route (code request 2). Self-grade A at game size (sheets art/ui/sheets/corner/board_L0*.png, wedge_L0*.png).

entries.purpose: corner, turn downRight (down->right, left->up): the blue coil spring + its domed foot (UNDER the plate) -- one of the two registered layers the hit animation moves (the canonical render)

ref.note: L70 cell (8, 14), facing (1, -1): plate faces up-right; the spring layer alone: the capture's other half peeks out on the sheet

entries.notes: corner lane: 2 x 2 pitch frame centred on the cell (anchor = frame centre), drawn at 32 pt/cell; the engine scales by pitch/32 and does NOT rotate it (the lighting is baked per turn). Hit animation (corner_anim.py): the spring scales along the facing s about its foot, cell centre + (-0.98 p) s, k = 1 + x / 0.694. Self-grade A.

entries.purpose: the Corner unlock card icon: the corner (red plate on the blue coil spring, plate facing up-right) at 73.4 pt per pitch

ref.note: the card over the dimmed L70 board; the sparkles around it are the live UnlockTwinkles

entries.notes: corner lane: the same model as the board sprite (card plate 92.5 pt long vs 26.0 pt on L70 at pitch 20.63 -> 73.4 pt per pitch) with a softer spring (rough 0.40), a lighter/longer foot, the spring graded onto 456's measured tone ramp and the plate's ends/back painted deep red (456: G 27/15/5 at u -0.4/+0.4/+0.58). Frame 100 x 100 pt CENTRED on 456's ink centre (196.55, 413.25); ink 149.6..244.6 x 365.9..461.9 pt (456: 150.3..242 x 367..458 + AA). No live text. UnlockOverlay needs its ink rect (code request 3): CGRect(146.55, 363.25, 100, 100) = the whole canvas. Self-grade A-/A.
